mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 20-day returns, as lower interest rates reduce discount rates and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL value above 235 predicts negative S&P 500 5-day returns, as rising inflation erodes real earnings and increases risk premia.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000, it signals a weakening labor market and demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE>5.0 and HOUST<1000.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions (defined by a quarterly decline in GDP, GDPC1), the S&P 500 tends to have negative 20-day returns due to heightened economic uncertainty and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 declines in the last quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% predicts negative S&P 500 20-day returns, as higher unemployment signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts (HOUST) is associated with higher S&P 500 20-day returns, as it signals a strengthening economy and increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above 1000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are above 1000 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it signals an overheating demand relative to supply, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns due to inflationary pressures and potential rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST>1000 and INDPRO<105.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) value below 105 predicts negative S&P 500 20-day returns, as it signals weakening industrial activity and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.
